## Legs: run vs queued

### Engineering legs — RAN (offline only)

- `connectors/field_denylist.py` + `data/field_denylist.toml` — F-330
  tokenized denylist (plate / red-vrm / hotlist / search-reason /
  first+last name / email / phone / address; alphanumeric-boundary
  normalization covers `ADDRESS1`). Enforced at `sig-connectors
  validate`, at generator target emission, and at
  `dot_511.registry_targets()` pre-expansion.
- `connectors/dot_511.py` — reviewed ArcGIS `out_fields` replace the
  wildcard only when an explicit allowlist is declared (legacy rows keep
  prior behavior); `rate_limit_per_min` propagates from `api_allowlist`
  through target expansion (NEW-3).
- `ops/src/ops/acq_gen.py` (`sig-ops acq-generate`) — plan+candidate join;
  R2 prefixes, ≤40-char lower-snake ids, no mid-token truncation;
  collision/ambiguous-prefix refusal; R1/NEW-1 dedupe (declared same-as,
  id-under-registered, same-channel) to targets under the existing row;
  NEW-5 recompute of `_2`/`_in` list suffixes; `ACQ-nn` → manifest ticket
  routing via `round11_plan.csv` (non-ACQ cells → `owned_elsewhere` with
  recorded owner; unresolved ACQ refs → errors); aggregate transports →
  manifest `pending_kind`, never a broken `[[targets]]`; **idempotent** —
  re-run over the committed registry reports `converged`, never NEW-1
  self-collisions.
- `ops/src/ops/scheduled.py` + `ops/gcp/scheduled-ops.sh` — `task_timeout`
  on source/batch rows (legistar 3h, R11 batches 6h, defaults 60m/36h)
  and `--paused` (create-then-pause for NEW triggers only; existing
  trigger state untouched; declared-paused maintenance stays paused).
- `ops/src/ops/coverage_delta.py` + `ops/coverage_dimensions.toml`
  (`sig-ops coverage-delta`) — dimensioned committed-snapshot deltas with
  expected explanations / plan-derived cells, JSON+text reports,
  `--fail-on-unexplained`.
- `ops/src/ops/wave_verify.py` (`sig-ops wave-verify`) — §7.7 checks;
  scope derived from `acq_gen.generate()` (deduped/owned-elsewhere/
  pending rows never read as missing registry rows); `--require
  machinery` keeps live-dependent checks pending — no synthetic green.
- `ops/src/ops/cli.py` — the three new verbs wired through the top-level
  parser.
- `tasks/acquisition.py` — queue join: homepage-URL collision with a
  *gated* row → `existing_unpermitted` (improvement under the registered

  `duplicate` refusal. (17 of the 27 P32.11 queue leads are the same

- `ops/iam_identities.toml` — `expected_job_count` 88 → 98 (the ten new

- `web/src/lib/jurisdictions.ts` — +26 `iso.3166_2` display names for the
